io.milvus.v2.service.vector.request.highlighter

Class SemanticHighlighter

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.milvus.v2.service.vector.request.highlighter.SemanticHighlighter
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    Highlighter

    public class SemanticHighlighter
extends Object
implements Highlighter
    A semantic highlighter used by the search API to highlight the passages of the returned text fields that are semantically relevant to the queries, using an embedding model.
